zh-CN.title: 长安—洛阳帝国走廊
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这条路线把两京之间的政治、教育、宗教与人员流动组织为可研究的空间骨架。
curatorialDescription: 路线不是一条精确复原道路，而是由城市、关隘、河谷和制度联系组成的研究模型。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需补充各时期道路分支、驿站、里程和 GIS 来源。

en.title: Chang'an–Luoyang imperial corridor
en.shortSummary: The route organizes political, educational, religious and human movement between the two capitals as a spatial research frame.
curatorialDescription: It is not a claim of one precisely reconstructed road, but a model built from cities, passes, valleys and institutional links.
en.researchNote: Period-specific branches, postal stations, distances and GIS sources remain to be added.

corridorNote.zh-CN: 这是两京之间的历史廊道模型，不表示单一路线或精确线位。
corridorNote.en: This is a historical corridor model between the capitals, not one road or a precise alignment.
